newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh to set up $75 mln fertiliser plant.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh to set up $75 mln fertiliser plant.

text.p: Bangladesh will set up a $75 million diammonium phosphate (DAP) plant with Chinese assistance, an official statement said. The statement issued on Sunday night said the plant, with an annual production capacity of 360,000 tonnes of manure, will be built in southeastern Chittagong. The Chinese assistance was agreed at a meeting between Wang Jinchou, vice president of Ch ina National Complete Plant Exim Corporation, and Bangladesh's Industries Minister Tofael Ahmed on Saturday, the statement said. China has agreed to finance the project with a soft loan, the statement said, without specifying the amount. "Bangladesh is very eager to set up the plant immediately.
